适配器模式

Monitoring Hands On: Using Prometheus for Monitoring Logging Hands On: Normalizing Different Logging Formats with fluentd Adding a Health Monitor Hands On: Adding Rich Health Monitoring for MySQL Summary

Adapters适配器模式

— PDF 第 59 页 —

In the preceding chapters, we saw how the sidecar pattern can extend and augment existing application containers. We also saw how ambassadors can alter and broker how an application container communicates with the external world. This chapter describes the final single-node pattern: the adapter pattern. In the adapter pattern, the adapter container is used to modify the interface of the application container so that it conforms to some predefined interface that is expected of all applications. For example, an adapter might ensure that an application implements a consistent monitoring interface. Or it might ensure that log files are always written to stdout or any number of other conventions.

在前几章中，我们看到了边车（sidecar）模式如何扩展和增强已有的应用容器；也看到了大使（ambassador）模式如何改变并代理应用容器与外部世界的通信。本章介绍最后一种单节点模式：适配器（adapter）模式。在适配器模式中，适配器容器用于修改应用容器的接口，使其符合某种预先定义、并被所有应用共同遵循的接口。例如，适配器可以确保某个应用实现一致的监控接口；或者确保日志文件总是写入 stdout，以及其他诸如此类的约定。

Real-world application development is a heterogeneous, hybrid exercise. Some parts of your application might be written from scratch by your team, some supplied by vendors, and some might consist entirely of off-the-shelf open source or proprietary software that you consume as precompiled binary. The net effect of this heterogeneity is that any real-world application you deploy will have been written in a variety of languages, with a variety of conventions for logging, monitoring, and other common services.

现实世界的应用开发是一项异构、混合的工作。应用的某些部分可能由你的团队从零编写，某些来自供应商，还有一些则完全由开箱即用的开源或专有软件构成——你只是把它们当作预编译好的二进制来使用。这种异构性的最终结果是：你部署的任何真实应用，都会由多种语言写成，并带有五花八门的日志、监控及其他通用服务约定。

Yet, to effectively monitor and operate your application, you need common interfaces. When each application provides metrics using a different format and interface, it is very difficult to collect all of those metrics in a single place for visualization and alerting. This is where the adapter pattern is relevant. Like other single-node patterns, the adapter pattern is made up of modular containers. Different application containers can present many different monitoring interfaces while the adapter container adapts this heterogeneity to present a consistent interface. This enables you to deploy a single tool that expects this single interface. Figure 5-1 illustrates this general pattern.

然而，要有效地监控和运维你的应用，你需要统一的接口。当每个应用都用不同的格式和接口暴露指标时，要把所有指标集中到一处做可视化和告警就非常困难。这正是适配器模式发挥作用的地方。与其他单节点模式一样，适配器模式由模块化容器构成：不同的应用容器可以呈现出千差万别的监控接口，而适配器容器则把这种异构性适配成统一接口。这样你就可以部署单一工具，让它只面对这一个统一接口。图 5-1 展示了这一通用模式。

— PDF 第 60 页 —

The remainder of this chapter gives several different applications of the adapter pattern.

本章余下部分将给出适配器模式的若干不同应用。

Monitoring监控

When monitoring your software, you want a single solution that can automatically discover and monitor any application that is deployed into your environment. To make this feasible, every application has to implement the same monitoring interface. There are numerous examples of standardized monitoring interfaces, such as syslog, Event Tracing for Windows (ETW), JMX for Java applications, and many, many other protocols and interfaces. However, each of these is unique in both protocol for communication as well as the style of communication (push versus pull).

在监控软件时，你希望有一套统一的方案，能够自动发现并监控部署到环境中的任何应用。要做到这一点，每个应用都必须实现相同的监控接口。标准化的监控接口有很多例子，例如 syslog、Windows 事件跟踪（ETW）、面向 Java 应用的 JMX，以及许许多多其他协议和接口。然而，这些接口在通信协议和通信方式（推 vs 拉）上各不相同。

Sadly, applications in your distributed system are likely to span the gamut from code that you have written yourself to off-the-shelf open source components. As a result, you will find yourself with a wide range of different monitoring interfaces that you need to integrate into a single well-understood system.

遗憾的是，你分布式系统中的应用很可能跨度极大——从你自己编写的代码，到开箱即用的开源组件。结果就是，你会发现自己面对着五花八门的监控接口，需要把它们集成进一个统一、清晰的系统中。

Fortunately, most monitoring solutions understand that they need to be widely applicable, and thus they have implemented a variety of plug-ins that can adapt one monitoring format to a common interface. Given this set of tools, how can we deploy and manage our applications in an agile and stable manner? Fortunately, the adapter pattern can provide us with the answers. Applying the adapter pattern to monitoring, we see that the application container is simply the application that we want to monitor. The adapter container contains the tools for transforming the monitoring interface exposed by the application container into the interface expected by the general-purpose monitoring system.

幸运的是，大多数监控方案都明白自己必须具备广泛的适用性，因此它们实现了各种各样的插件，能够把某种监控格式适配到统一接口上。有了这套工具，我们该如何以敏捷而稳定的方式部署和管理应用呢？幸运的是，适配器模式可以给我们答案。把适配器模式应用到监控上：应用容器就是我们想要监控的那个应用；适配器容器则包含了相应工具，把应用容器暴露的监控接口转换为通用监控系统所期望的接口。

— PDF 第 61 页 —

Decoupling the system in this fashion makes for a more comprehensible, maintainable system. Rolling out new versions of the application doesn’t require a rollout of the monitoring adapter. Additionally, the monitoring container can be reused with multiple different application containers. The monitoring container may even have been supplied by the monitoring system maintainers independent of the application developers. Finally, deploying the monitoring adapter as a separate container ensures that each container gets its own dedicated resources in terms of both CPU and memory. This ensures that a misbehaving monitoring adapter cannot cause problems with a user-facing service.

以这种方式把系统解耦，会让系统更易理解、更易维护。发布新版本的应用时，不需要同步发布监控适配器。此外，监控容器可以被多个不同的应用容器复用；这个监控容器甚至可能由监控系统的维护者独立于应用开发者提供。最后，把监控适配器作为独立容器部署，还能确保每个容器都拥有自己专属的 CPU 与内存资源，从而保证一个行为异常的监控适配器不会给面向用户的服务带来问题。

Hands On: Using Prometheus for Monitoring动手实践：用 Prometheus 做监控

As an example, consider monitoring your containers via the Prometheus open source project. Prometheus is a monitoring aggregator, which collects metrics and aggregates them into a single time-series database. On top of this database, Prometheus provides visualization and query language for introspecting the collected metrics. To collect metrics from a variety of different systems, Prometheus expects every container to expose a specific metrics API. This enables Prometheus to monitor a wide variety of different programs through a single interface.

举个例子，考虑通过开源项目 Prometheus 来监控你的容器。Prometheus 是一个监控聚合器，它收集指标并将其聚合到一个单一的时序数据库中。在这个数据库之上，Prometheus 提供了可视化与查询语言，用于洞察所采集到的指标。为了从各种不同系统中采集指标，Prometheus 要求每个容器都暴露一个特定的指标 API，这样它就能通过单一接口监控种类繁多的不同程序。

However, many popular programs, such as the Redis key-value store, do not export metrics in a format that is compatible with Prometheus. Consequently, the adapter pattern is quite useful for taking an existing service like Redis and adapting it to the Prometheus metrics-collection interface.

然而，许多流行程序（例如 Redis 键值存储）并不会以兼容 Prometheus 的格式导出指标。因此，适配器模式在这里就非常有用：它把像 Redis 这样的既有服务，适配到 Prometheus 的指标采集接口上。

Consider a simple Kubernetes pod definition for a Redis server:

下面是一个 Redis 服务器的简单 Kubernetes Pod 定义：

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: adapter-example
  namespace: default
spec:
  containers:
  - image: redis
    name: redis

At this point, this container is not capable of being monitored by Prometheus because it does not export the right interface. However, if we simply add an adapter container (in this case, an open source Prometheus exporter), we can modify this pod to export the correct interface and thus adapt it to fit Prometheus’s expectations:

此时，这个容器还不能被 Prometheus 监控，因为它没有导出正确的接口。但是，只要我们简单地加上一个适配器容器（这里是一个开源的 Prometheus exporter），就可以修改这个 Pod，使其导出正确的接口，从而适配 Prometheus 的预期：

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: adapter-example
  namespace: default
spec:
  containers:
  - image: redis
    name: redis
 # Provide an adapter that implements the Prometheus interface
  - image: oliver006/redis_exporter
    name: adapter
— PDF 第 62 页 —

This example illustrates not only the value of the adapter pattern for ensuring a consistent interface, but also the value of container patterns in general for modular container reuse. In this case, the example shown combines an existing Redis container with an existing Prometheus adapter. The net effect is a monitorable Redis server, with little work on our part to deploy it. In the absence of the adapter pattern, the same deployment would have required significantly more custom work and would have resulted in a much less operable solution, since any updates to either Redis or the adapter would have required work to apply the update.

这个例子不仅展示了适配器模式在保证接口一致性方面的价值，也展示了容器模式在模块化容器复用方面的普遍价值。本例把一个既有的 Redis 容器与一个既有的 Prometheus 适配器组合在一起，最终效果就是一个可被监控的 Redis 服务器，而我们几乎不需要做什么部署工作。如果没有适配器模式，同样的部署将需要大量定制工作，并且最终得到的方案可运维性也差得多——因为无论是 Redis 还是适配器的任何更新，都需要额外工作才能应用上去。

Logging日志

Much like monitoring, there is a wide variety of heterogeneity in how systems log data to an output stream. Systems might divide their logs into different levels (such as debug, info, warning, and error) with each level going into a different file. Some might simply log to stdout and stderr. This is especially problematic in the world of containerized applications, where there is a general expectation that your containers will log to stdout, because that is what is available via commands like docker logs or kubectl logs.

与监控非常类似，系统把数据输出到日志流的方式也存在着极大的异构性。有些系统会把日志分成不同级别（如 debug、info、warning、error），每个级别写到不同的文件；有些则简单地输出到 stdout 和 stderr。在容器化应用的世界里，这尤其成问题——因为大家普遍期望容器把日志写到 stdout，毕竟 `docker logs` 或 `kubectl logs` 这类命令只能拿到 stdout 的内容。

Adding further complexity, the information logged generally has structured information (e.g., the date/time of the log), but this information varies widely between different logging libraries (e.g., Java’s built-in logging versus the glog package for Go). Of course, when you are storing and querying the logs for your distributed system, you don’t really care about these differences in logging format. You want to ensure that despite different structures for the data, every log ends up with the appropriate timestamp.

更复杂的是，日志中通常带有结构化信息（例如日志的日期/时间），但这些信息在不同日志库之间差异很大（例如 Java 内置日志与 Go 的 glog 包）。当然，当你存储和查询分布式系统的日志时，你并不真正关心这些日志格式上的差异；你只希望确保：尽管数据结构各不相同，每条日志最终都带上恰当的时间戳。

Fortunately, as with monitoring, the adapter pattern can help provide a modular, reusable design for both of these situations. While the application container may log to a file, the adapter container can redirect that file to stdout. Different application containers can log information in different formats, but the adapter container can transform that data into a single structured representation that can be consumed by your log aggregator. Again, the adapter is taking a heterogeneous world of applications and creating a homogenous world of common interfaces.

幸运的是，与监控一样，适配器模式可以为这两种情况提供模块化、可复用的设计。当应用容器把日志写到文件时，适配器容器可以把该文件重定向到 stdout；不同应用容器可以用不同格式记录信息，但适配器容器可以把这些数据转换为统一的结构化表示，供你的日志聚合器消费。再一次，适配器把一个异构的应用世界，变成了一个拥有统一接口的同质世界。

— PDF 第 63 页 —

One question that often comes up when considering adapter patterns is: why not simply modify the application container itself? If you are the developer responsible for the application container, then this might actually be a good solution. Adapting your code or your container to implement a consistent interface can work well. However, in many cases we are reusing a container produced by another party. In such cases, deriving a slightly modified image that we have to maintain (patch, rebase, etc.) is significantly more expensive than developing an adapter container that can run alongside the other party’s image. Additionally, decoupling the adapter into its own container allows for the possibility of sharing and reuse, which isn’t possible when you modify the application container.

在考虑适配器模式时，经常会冒出一个问题：为什么不直接修改应用容器本身呢？如果你就是负责这个应用容器的开发者，那这或许确实是个不错的方案。把自己的代码或容器改成实现统一接口，效果可以很好。然而在很多情况下，我们复用的是别人生产的容器。这时，派生一个需要自己维护（打补丁、变基等）的小幅修改镜像，其成本远高于开发一个可以与对方镜像并行运行的适配器容器。此外，把适配器解耦到独立容器中，还带来了共享与复用的可能——而当你直接修改应用容器时，这是做不到的。

Hands On: Normalizing Different Logging Formats with fluentd动手实践：用 fluentd 规范化不同日志格式

One common task for an adapter is to normalize log metrics into a standard set of events. Many different applications have different output formats, but you can use a standard logging tool deployed as an adapter to normalize them all to a consistent format. In this example, we will use the fluentd monitoring agent as well as some community-supported plug-ins to obtain logs from a variety of different sources.

适配器的一项常见任务，就是把各种日志指标规范化为一组标准事件。许多不同应用有不同的输出格式，但你可以用一个作为适配器部署的标准日志工具，把它们全部规范化为一致的格式。在这个例子中，我们将使用 fluentd 监控代理以及一些社区支持的插件，从各种不同来源采集日志。

fluentd is one of the more popular open source logging agents available. One of its major features is a rich set of community-supported plug-ins that enable a great deal of flexibility in monitoring a variety of applications.

fluentd 是当下比较流行的开源日志代理之一。它的一大特色是拥有丰富的社区插件集，使得监控各种应用时具备极大的灵活性。

The first application that we will monitor is Redis. Redis is a popular key-value store; one of the commands it offers is the SLOWLOG command. This command lists recent queries that exceeded a particular time interval. Such information is quite useful in debugging your application’s performance. Unfortunately, SLOWLOG is only available as a command on the Redis server, which means that it is difficult to use retrospectively if a problem happens when someone isn’t available to debug the server. To fix this limitation, we can use fluentd and the adapter pattern to add slow-query logging to Redis.

我们要监控的第一个应用是 Redis。Redis 是流行的键值存储，它提供的命令中有一个叫做 SLOWLOG。该命令会列出最近超过特定时间阈值的查询。这类信息在调试应用性能时非常有用。遗憾的是，SLOWLOG 只能作为 Redis 服务器上的一个命令来使用，这意味着：如果问题发生时没人在场调试服务器，事后就很难回溯。为解决这一局限，我们可以用 fluentd 加上适配器模式，为 Redis 增加慢查询日志。

To do this, we use the adapter pattern with a redis container as the main application container, and the fluentd container as our adapter container. In this case, we will also use the fluent-plugin-redis-slowlog fluentd plug-in to listen to the slow queries. We can configure this plug-in by using the following snippet:

为此，我们使用适配器模式：把 redis 容器作为主应用容器，把 fluentd 容器作为适配器容器。这里我们还会使用 fluent-plugin-redis-slowlog 这个 fluentd 插件来监听慢查询。该插件可以通过下面这段配置片段来设置：

— PDF 第 64 页 —

  type redis_slowlog
  host localhost
  port 6379
  tag redis.slowlog

Because we are using an adapter and the containers both share a network namespace, configuring the logging simply uses localhost and the default Redis port (6379). Given this application of the adapter pattern, logging will always be available whenever we want to debug slow Redis queries.

由于我们使用了适配器，且两个容器共享同一个网络命名空间，配置日志时直接写 localhost 和 Redis 默认端口（6379）即可。有了这种适配器模式的应用，今后每当我们想调试 Redis 慢查询时，日志都随时可用。

A similar exercise can be done to monitor logs from the Apache Storm system. Again, Storm provides data via a RESTful API, which is useful but has limitations if we are not currently monitoring the system when a problem occurs. Like Redis, we can use a fluentd adapter to transform the Storm process into a time series of queryable logs.

类似的做法也可以用来监控 Apache Storm 系统的日志。同样，Storm 通过 RESTful API 提供数据，这很有用，但如果问题发生时我们没有正在监控该系统，就会有局限。与 Redis 一样，我们可以用一个 fluentd 适配器，把 Storm 进程转换为可查询的日志时序数据。

To do this, we deploy a fluentd adapter with the fluent-plugin-storm plug-in enabled. We can configure this plug-in with a fluentd config pointed at localhost (because again, we are running as a container group with a shared localhost); the config for the plug-in looks like:

为此，我们部署一个启用了 fluent-plugin-storm 插件的 fluentd 适配器。我们可以用一份指向 localhost 的 fluentd 配置来配置该插件（因为同样，我们是以共享 localhost 的容器组形式运行的）；插件配置如下：


  type storm
  tag storm
  url http://localhost:8080
  window 600
  sys 0

This adapter builds a bridge between Storm and the time series of logs.

这个适配器在 Storm 与日志时序之间架起了一座桥梁。

Adding a Health Monitor增加健康监控

One last example of applying the adapter pattern is derived from monitoring the health of an application container. Consider the task of monitoring the health of an off-the-shelf database container. In this case, the container for the database is supplied by the database project, and we would rather not modify that container simply to add health checks. Of course, a container orchestrator will allow us to add simple health checks to ensure that the process is running and that it is listening on a particular port, but what if we want to add richer health checks that actually run queries against the database?

应用适配器模式的最后一个例子，来自对应用容器健康状态的监控。考虑监控一个开箱即用的数据库容器的健康状态这个任务。此时，数据库容器是由数据库项目方提供的，我们不想仅仅为了加健康检查就去修改那个容器。当然，容器编排器允许我们添加简单的健康检查，以确保进程在运行、并且在某个端口上监听；但如果我们想加入更丰富的、真正向数据库发起查询的健康检查呢？

Container orchestration systems like Kubernetes enable us to use shell scripts as health checks as well. Given this capability, we can write a rich shell script that runs a number of different diagnostic queries against the database to determine its health. But where can we store such a script and how can we version it?

像 Kubernetes 这样的容器编排系统，还允许我们把 shell 脚本用作健康检查。有了这种能力，我们就可以编写一个内容丰富的 shell 脚本，对数据库执行若干不同的诊断查询来判断其健康状态。但这样的脚本我们该存在哪里？又该如何对它做版本管理？

— PDF 第 65 页 —

The answer to these problems should be easy to guess by now: we can use an adapter container. The database runs in the application container and shares a network interface with the adapter container. The adapter container is a simple container that only contains the shell script for determining the health of the database. This script can then be set up as the health check for the database container and can perform whatever rich health checks our application requires. If these checks ever fail, the database will be automatically restarted.

这些问题的答案现在应该不难猜到了：我们可以用一个适配器容器。数据库运行在应用容器中，并与适配器容器共享同一个网络接口。适配器容器是一个简单容器，里面只装着用于判断数据库健康状态的 shell 脚本。这个脚本随后可以被设置为数据库容器的健康检查，并能执行我们应用所需的任何丰富的健康检查。一旦这些检查失败，数据库就会被自动重启。

Hands On: Adding Rich Health Monitoring for MySQL动手实践：为 MySQL 添加丰富的健康监控

Suppose, then, that you want to add deep monitoring on a MySQL database where you actually run a query that is representative of your workload. In this case, one option would be to update the MySQL container to contain a health check that is specific to your application. However, this is generally an unattractive idea because it requires that you both modify some existing MySQL base image as well as update that image as new MySQL images are released.

假设你想在一个 MySQL 数据库上增加深度监控——实际跑一条能代表你业务负载的查询。这时，一种做法是修改 MySQL 容器，让它内置一个专属于你应用的健康检查。然而这通常并不划算，因为这意味着你既要修改某个既有 MySQL 基础镜像，又要在每个新 MySQL 镜像发布时同步更新该镜像。

Using the adapter pattern is a much more attractive approach to adding health checks to your database container. Instead of modifying the existing MySQL container, you can add an additional adapter container to the preexisting MySQL container, which runs the appropriate query to test the database health. Given that this adapter container implements the expected HTTP health check, it is simply a case of defining the MySQL database process’s health check in terms of the interface exposed by this database adapter.

使用适配器模式是一种更具吸引力的方式来为数据库容器添加健康检查。你不必修改既有 MySQL 容器，而是在已有的 MySQL 容器旁边再加一个适配器容器，由它运行相应的查询来测试数据库健康状态。由于这个适配器容器实现了所期望的 HTTP 健康检查接口，剩下的工作无非就是：用这个数据库适配器所暴露的接口，来定义 MySQL 数据库进程的健康检查。

The source code for this adapter is relatively straightforward and looks like this in Go (though clearly other language implementations are possible as well):

这个适配器的源代码相当直白，下面是它在 Go 中的样子（当然，用其他语言实现也完全可以）：

— PDF 第 66 页 —
package main

import (
        "database/sql"
        "flag"
        "fmt"
        "net/http"

        _ "github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"
)

var (
        user   = flag.String("user", "", "The database user name")
        passwd = flag.String("password", "", "The database password")
        db     = flag.String("database", "", "The database to connect to")
        query  = flag.String("query", "", "The test query")
        addr   = flag.String("address", "localhost:8080",
                            "The address to listen on")
)
// Basic usage:
//   db-check --query="SELECT * from my-cool-table" \
//            --user=bdburns \
//            --passwd="you wish"
//
func main() {
        flag.Parse()
        db, err := sql.Open("localhost",
                            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s@/%s", *user, *passwd, *db))
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("Error opening database: %v", err)
        }

 // Simple web handler that runs the query
        http.HandleFunc("", func(res http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
                _, err := db.Exec(*query)
                if err != nil {
                        res.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
                        res.Write([]byte(err.Error()))
                        return
                }
                res.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
                res.Write([]byte("OK"))
                return
        })
 // Startup the server
        http.ListenAndServe(*addr, nil)
}

We can then build this into a container image and pull it into a pod that looks like:

随后我们可以把它构建成容器镜像，并把它放进一个像这样的 Pod 中：

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: adapter-example-health
  namespace: default
spec:
  containers:
  - image: mysql
    name: mysql
  - image: brendanburns/mysql-adapter
    name: adapter

That way, the mysql container is unchanged, but the desired feedback about the health of the MySQL server can still be obtained from the adapter container.

这样一来，mysql 容器完全没有改动，但我们所期望的关于 MySQL 服务器健康状态的反馈，仍然可以从适配器容器获得。

When looking at this application of the adapter pattern, it may seem like applying the pattern is superfluous. Clearly we could have built our own custom image that knew how to health check the mysql instance itself.

看到这里，你也许会觉得应用适配器模式显得多余——毕竟我们完全可以自己构建一个定制镜像，让它自己就知道如何对 mysql 实例做健康检查。

— PDF 第 67 页 —

While this is true, this method ignores the strong benefits that derive from modularity. If every developer implements their own specific container with health checking built in, there are no opportunities for reuse or sharing.

这话不假，但这种做法忽视了模块化带来的巨大收益。如果每个开发者都自己实现一个内置健康检查的专用容器，那就根本没有复用和共享的机会。

In contrast, if we use patterns like the adapter to develop modular solutions comprised of multiple containers, the work is inherently decoupled and more easily shared. An adapter that is developed to health check mysql is a module that can be shared and reused by a variety of people. Further, people can apply the adapter pattern using this shared health-checking container, without having deep knowledge of how to health check a mysql database. Thus the modularity and adapter pattern serve not to just facilitate sharing, but also to empower people to take advantage of the knowledge of others.

相反，如果我们用适配器这类模式去开发由多个容器组成的模块化方案，工作本身就是解耦的，也更容易被共享。一个为 mysql 健康检查而开发的适配器，是一个可以被许多人共享和复用的模块。更进一步，人们可以使用这个共享的健康检查容器来应用适配器模式，而无需深入了解如何对 mysql 数据库做健康检查。因此，模块化与适配器模式不仅促进了共享，还让人们能够借助他人的知识。

Sometimes design patterns aren’t just for the developers who apply them, but lead to the development of communities that can collaborate and share solutions between members of the community as well as the broader developer ecosystem.

有时，设计模式不仅仅服务于使用它们的开发者，还会促成社区的发展——让社区成员之间、以及社区与更广泛的开发者生态之间，能够协作并共享解决方案。

Summary小结

Sometimes the world isn’t perfectly aligned. The components that we need to use to build our systems can have different interfaces or different protocols for interactions like logging, monitoring, and RPCs. Adapters can be a critical tool to add consistency to our systems, enabling them to share a consistent protocol and way of connecting. Using an adapter is often significantly easier than trying to change the upstream project.

有时候，世界并不那么整齐划一。我们用来构建系统的各个组件，在日志、监控、RPC 等交互上可能拥有不同的接口或不同的协议。适配器可以成为一个关键工具，为我们的系统带来一致性，使它们共享同一套协议与连接方式。使用适配器，往往比试图修改上游项目要容易得多。
